faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NAAC Project Assistant recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application for the NAAC Project Assistant position is 09-09-2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's Degree with at least 2 years of research experience or a PhD to be eligible for the Project Assistant role.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the NAAC Project Assistant position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Project Assistant post is 40 years.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Assistant role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Project Assistant position will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 40,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. How will candidates be selected for the Project Assistant position?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Project Assistant role primarily involves an Application Review stage.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for the NAAC Project Assistant recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the form and submit it via post.

faq.question: Q8. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the post of Project Assistant in the National Assessment and Accreditation Council (NAAC).

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The Project Assistant position is a contractual role, meaning it is offered on a fixed-term contract basis.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the NAAC located?
faq.answer: The National Assessment and Accreditation Council (NAAC) is located in Bengaluru, Karnataka, with a pincode of 560072.
